text:
Situation: Potassium phosphate 224 mg/mL 15 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 227 vials at 10.3 vials per day (22.1 days on hand). Corvale General holds 412 vials at 12.9 vials per day (31.9 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include potassium phosphate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks at both sites. No FDA shortage designation exists. Multiple suppliers show product available and are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with B. Braun Medical Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify CIVICA, INC. as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Somerset Therapeutics, LLC as additional option; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to review inventory weekly and adjust par levels; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
